description:
## Purpose
Umbrella for one feature branch and one pull request. Members: tpcds-below-floor-error-type-and-wording-20261120, tpcds-q9-generation-above-sf5000-owner-decision-20261120, interactive-official-mode-offers-sf30-for-tpcds-20261120.

## Decision gates
No scale factor is refused that develop accepts today. No change to how any query is generated, to the 30-second dsqgen limit, or to the accepted range.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the pull request merges through `make pr-arm`; each member's rubric is met at the merged head.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
